0.original: Laxio the sylph needs help to put down djiggas.

1.original: Laxio explains that his people are being preyed upon by buzzing djiggas whenever they venture outside Little Solace to bathe in sunlight. He has instructed a pair of sylphs to act as bait to lure the ravenous parasites into the open, and asks that you put the vilekin down.

2.original: You have exterminated the djiggas. Report back to Laxio at Little Solace.

3.original: Back at Little Solace, you learn that sylphs need sunlight in order to survive. Thanks to your help, they can now get their required dose without becoming djigga fodder.

24.original: Defeat buzzing djiggas at the specified location.

25.original: Report to Laxio at Little Solace.

48.original: These ones need help! Please help these ones!

49.original: Vile ones called buzzing djiggas think these ones are food. Attack these ones! Attack whenever these ones go into the forest to bathe in sunlight!

50.original: Some of these ones have gone into the forest─into the forest to lure out vile ones. This one wants walking one to wait for vile ones─wait nearby and slay vile ones that come.

52.original: These ones must bathe in sunlight to survive. Without sunlight, these ones will fall ill─fall ill and shrivel away to no ones!

53.original: Thanks to walking one, these ones can safely bathe in sunlight again! Praise be to walking one!
